recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片整個視野只有一顆小淋巴球，看不到嗜中性球，血小板也很少，並有散在的棘狀紅血球（echinocytes）；呈現血球減少的樣貌，但本身不能診斷噬血症候群。
features: Only a single small mature lymphocyte in the field; no neutrophils seen
Red cells largely normocytic with scattered crenated/echinocytic forms
No blasts, schistocytes or nucleated red cells identified
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells that are largely normocytic with scattered crenated forms (echinocytes), and very few platelets. A single small mature lymphocyte is the only leukocyte in the field, and no neutrophils are identified. No blasts or schistocytes are seen. Findings suggest leukopenia and thrombocytopenia, consistent with the cytopenias of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, although the peripheral smear itself is nonspecific.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows a hypocellular marrow without histiocytic activation, fever, splenomegaly or hyperferritinemia.
Leukemia usually shows circulating blasts and a marrow blast excess.
Crenated cells from delayed smear preparation are artifactual and do not indicate disease.
